# Icon Cutter v1.0.0
- Round image corners and export transparent PNGs. - Remove connected black backgrounds with adjustable strength and undo. - Drag to adjust the crop; save to the source image folder by default. - Check for updates from the app menu or automatically every seven days after a successful check. - Update downloads start only after you choose to update.
Made by Hyo Suk Nam · https://store.brainok.net
